t:
3rd November: 4-0 W vs Monks FC

"Back to back Champions of the Elephant and Castle Tuesday 7aside Premier League, how does that sound?"

It sounds good, real good. 

With the CR7 result still with league administrators, a win vs Monks could put this season beyond all doubt and it would be the old achilles heel of 5Oh!5 tested one more time: playing against 6.

A defensive team selection meant we had 7 idiots plus Millsy desperately trying to work out what to do with all their new found time and space. Monks wisely parked the bus and asked us to break them down. We politely declined.

Fortunately, DMac nudged us ahead and you hoped flood gates would open. Have you ever watched us play before? How naive a suggestion.

We broke glass for emergency CH9 and a dinked ball found his feet back to goal. An annoyingly sharp turn combined with mysterious goalkeeper positioning left him the simplest of finishes and the TV cameras cut to the engraver starting to etch 5 on the silverware.

A second half of similarly fleeting quality allowed Hugh to put a cross back across his body into the bottom corner before ID made it 4.

Throughout all of this action, Gibbs demands for increased service up top had fallen on deaf ears. Millsy took it upon himself in an act of great kindness to split the defence, round the keeper and finally put it on a plate for JG9. Gibb was clearly also feeling generous and instead of kicking the 6 men of Monks while they were already down, saved them the embarrassment of conceding a Gibb goal by rolling the ball tamely across the face of an empty net. Not his best work and yet you fear, not the worst we'll ever see in 5Oh!5 colours. There's always next time Gibbo! 

Deserved champions. Good teams go twice etc etc. We did it all with a target on our back. Champions again ole ole.

(Nuges mates beat Darby and look a serious outfit but can they get it done on a wet Tuesday night vs 5Oh!5? Very few can)

Squad: CH ID Pierre Hugh Yoz Millsy Gibb DMac
Goals: CH ID Hugh DMac - some odds you'd have got on that acca btw
